title: Symbol of Wrath/Skill history
wikitext:
{{Skill history}}
== [[Feedback:Game_updates/20260624|June 24, 2026]] ==
* Reduced activation time from 2 to 1 seconds.
* Reduced recharge from 30 to 20 seconds.
* Increased damage from {{gr|8|32}} to {{gr|10|40}}.
* Changed functionality so that the AoE pulse happens at the target’s location instead of the caster’s. This skill is no longer a duplicate of {{skill icon|Kirin's Wrath}}.
